2607.17070.title: Bridging the Information Gap: Semantic Densification and Hindsight Distillation for Cold-Start Prediction
2607.17070.paper_summary: New-user cold-start is a critical bottleneck for e-commerce platforms: predicting user lifetime value (LTV) and conversion rate (CVR) for users with sparse interaction history. Two prior directions -- LLM-based semantic augmentation and learning using privileged information (LUPI) -- each face a key limitation. First, LLM augmentation produces unstructured rationales that are noisy and hard to operationalize in production. Second, naive student-teacher distillation can be brittle due to an information gap between the privileged teacher and the sparse student; moreover, this gap is heterogeneous across users. We propose SemRaD, a Semantic Reasoning-aware Distillation framework addressing both limitations. First, a Structured Semantic Reasoning Pipeline replaces free-form rationales with a structured schema built via a discover-curate-audit workflow, producing per user a Densified Semantic Profile (consumed by the deployed student via a Semantic-Gated Encoder that focuses on the most informative dimensions) and a Hindsight Distillation Target reconciled from pre- and post-conversion reasoning (used only at training). Second, to bridge this gap and handle its heterogeneity, a Hindsight-Aware Distillation Network transfers privileged knowledge via the hindsight target, with Distillation Experts improving transfer under per-user variability. On a large-scale industrial dataset, SemRaD lifts +1.9% LTV (Gini) and +1.0% CVR (AUROC) over a production-grade base; a four-week online A/B at Keeta confirms +1.0% LTV / +0.43% CVR. SemRaD also matches the production system's LTV using only 9% of the training data while improving CVR by 0.8%.
2607.17070.paper_summary_zh: 新用戶冷啟動是電子商務平台的一個關鍵瓶頸：對於互動歷史稀疏的用戶，預測用戶終身價值（LTV）和轉換率（CVR）。兩個先前的方向——基於LLM的語義增強和使用特權信息的學習（LUPI）——各自面臨一個關鍵限制。首先，LLM增強產生的非結構化理由噪聲較大，且在生產中難以操作化。其次，天真的學生-教師蒸餾可能因特權教師和稀疏學生之間的信息差距而脆弱；此外，這一差距在用戶之間是異質的。我們提出了SemRaD，一個語義推理感知的蒸餾框架，解決了這兩個限制。首先，結構化語義推理管道用一個通過發現-策劃-審核工作流程構建的結構化模式替代自由形式的理由，為每個用戶生成一個密集的語義檔案（通過專注於最具信息維度的語義門控編碼器消耗）和一個從轉換前後推理中調和的後見蒸餾目標（僅在訓練中使用）。其次，為了彌補這一差距並處理其異質性，後見感知蒸餾網絡通過後見目標轉移特權知識，蒸餾專家在每個用戶的變異性下改善轉移。在一個大規模的工業數據集上，SemRaD使LTV（Gini）提升了+1.9%和CVR（AUROC）提升了+1.0%相較於生產級基準；在Keeta進行的為期四週的在線A/B測試確認了+1.0% LTV / +0.43% CVR。SemRaD還僅使用9%的訓練數據便達到了生產系統的LTV，同時CVR提升了0.8%。
